pr_comments: Maybe for automating it would be nice to have both since starting and charging means the same (its charging) right?

> Maybe for automating it would be nice to have both since starting and charging means the same (its charging) right?

Starting is the step _before_ charging actually begins, when the car negotiates with the EVSE. It's very possible for it to go from starting to stopped if there is an issue.

Have no issue keeping it though, just felt like it was a duplicate at that point.

For clarity, at a minimum Starting may transition to:
* Charging
* Stopped
* NoPower

I guess in theory it can also transition to Disconnected as well, but FWIW I've not seen that happen.

issue_context.title: Tessie integration charging sensor is not binary
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The charging sensor in the Tessie integration, derived from Tessie's state->charge_state->charging_state, is currently of type 'binary_sensor'. It should however, be of type 'sensor' as the value of this variable is not binary.

The variable has 6 states:

* Starting
* Charging
* Stopped
* Complete
* Disconnected
* NoPower

State 'Complete' is necessary for charging automation, while state 'NoPower' is necessary for failure detection.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.1.2
